title: Escalation Traceability & Decision Fabric for Top Accounts
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Background: Over the last 6 quarters we have recurring top-account escalations that lead to ad-hoc roadmap promises with limited auditability. That creates ambiguity across Sales, Solutions, and Eng about what was committed and why. This ticket scopes a decision fabric and persistent traceability layer to capture escalation signals, structured decision inputs, outcome commitments, and automatic rollback triggers.

Goals: 1) Ensure every top-account escalation is instrumented end-to-end from intake -> decision -> commitment -> delivery or rollback. 2) Reduce cross-org friction by standardizing decision templates and ownership handoffs. 3) Surface a compliance-grade audit trail in Console and in customer-facing commitment letters. 4) Drive measurables: reduce time-to-decision to <72h for P0 escalations, reduce untracked roadmap addenda by 80% in the quarter.

Scope: - Intake schema additions (severity, customer-tier signals, supporting artifacts). - Decision templates for PM/Eng/Legal/Customer Success with required evidence fields. - A Decision Outcome object type stored in the product metadata service (links to release, PR, rollout policy). - Console view (read-only) of escalation timelines and decision traces for internal users; printable/exportable commitment snapshots for account teams. - Rollback ruleset: trigger conditions (quality regression, missed delivery windows, security flags) and automated notification paths. - Lightweight automation to auto-create follow-up Linear tickets for delivery and postmortems.

Out of scope: full legal contract generation, billing adjustments automation, major UI redesigns beyond a focused Console panel.

Proposed approach: 1) Define Intake + Decision templates in Confluence (iterative). 2) Add persistent Decision object in metadata service (minimal schema). 3) Add webhook that annotates Linear ticket with Decision key and generates follow-up ENG and SUPPORT tickets. 4) Build Console panel: timeline, evidence preview, download commitment snapshot. 5) Pilot with 3 active top accounts for one cycle, collect feedback, iterate.

Trade-offs & risks: - We avoid embedding contract text (legal work) to reduce compliance risk; instead link to legal artifacts. - Data sensitivity: decision traces may include PII or customer secrets; we will enforce RBAC and audit logging (handled by Security). - Implementation time for metadata object must be small; otherwise we risk long-lived partial rollout.

Success metrics (initial): - 90% of P0 top-account escalations use the Decision template in pilot. - Average decision latency <=72 hours. - Commitment snapshot download used in 100% of pilot account handoffs.
acceptance_criteria: Escalation intake fields (severity, customer-tier, summary, required artifacts) are present and required for P0/P1 top-account escalations
Decision Outcome objects are stored in metadata service and linked to Linear tickets via a stable Decision key
Console panel shows a chronological timeline with intake, decisions, follow-up tickets, and final commitment snapshot
Automation creates ENG and SUPPORT follow-up tickets with prefilled context within 10 minutes of decision being recorded
Rollback ruleset is configurable and a sample automated rollback notification flow executes in staging
Pilot performed on 3 accounts with post-pilot retrospective and list of 10 prioritized improvements
